verdict.rationale: Phoenix supports dataset-level bulk operations — grouping traces into datasets, running experiments across many examples at once, batch scoring via evaluators, and running 'thousands of evaluations without writing retry/concurrency logic' — which are genuine bulk operations across many items. However, there's no evidence of bulk operations on other entities (e.g., bulk editing/deleting traces, bulk annotation, bulk prompt updates) beyond the dataset/experiment/eval workflow. missing for 10: evidence of bulk actions outside datasets/evals (bulk trace management, bulk annotation edits, bulk prompt/version operations), and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk-scale performance.
